fichas.title: Rubbish Collection Rooms
fichas.summary: Rubbish collection rooms provide temporary storage for separately collected waste in tightly closed, appropriately sized containers. They should be safely accessible to waste-disposal providers, either inside or outside the building. For qualifying buildings, model building regulations specify fire-resisting construction, fire-retarding self-closing openings from inside, direct emptying from the open air, and constant effective ventilation. Outdoor bin-storage areas may be subject to separation distances, paving, and access requirements. Commercial-refuse rooms should be at ground level near delivery areas; large waste quantities may warrant crushers or presses, and food-waste rooms must be cooled.
